tagline: North America's largest deathcare provider with Dignity Memorial brand
hero_kpi_rationale: The $17.0 billion backlog of future revenues from prepaid funeral and cemetery service sales provides remarkable visibility into future revenues and demonstrates the predictable stability of cash flow.

kpis.name: Backlog de revenus futurs
kpis.explanation: Future revenues from the sale of prepaid death goods and services (trust and insurance)
kpis.description: The backlog of future revenues is a key indicator of the company's financial health and its ability to generate stable and predictable long-term revenues.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of stability and predictability of future revenues

kpis.name: Cash flow opérationnel
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated by funeral and cemetery service operations
kpis.description: The $942.8 million in operating cash flow demonstrates the company's ability to generate cash flow resilient to economic cycles and to fund its operations.
kpis.signal: Core financial strength and operational flexibility

kpis.name: Dette courante à long terme
kpis.explanation: Amount of long-term debt due within the next 12 months
kpis.description: The $56.8 million in current maturities of long-term debt reflect a favorable maturity profile and the company's ability to effectively manage its capital structure.
kpis.signal: Prudent management of debt maturity profile

kpis.name: Ratio de levier
kpis.description: The leverage ratio of 3.67x is in line with industry financing standards and the strategic target of 3.5x to 4.0x, demonstrating balanced capital structure management.
kpis.signal: Positioning within the 3.5x to 4.0x leverage target range

kpis.name: Dividende trimestriel
kpis.explanation: Quarterly dividend paid to common shareholders
kpis.description: The $0.34 per share quarterly dividend represents consistent growth since 2005 ($0.025) and demonstrates the company's commitment to returning value to shareholders while maintaining a prudent capital structure.
kpis.signal: Commitment to shareholder returns with consistent growth since 2005

kpis.name: Nb sites funéraires
kpis.explanation: Number of funeral service locations operated by the company in North America
kpis.description: The network of 1,485 funeral service locations represents the largest geographic coverage in the industry and enables the company to serve approximately 700,000 families annually under the Dignity Memorial brand.
kpis.signal: Leading geographic scale and unmatched network in North America

kpis.name: Nombre de cimetières exploités
kpis.explanation: Number of cemeteries operated by the company, including combined funeral service and cemetery sites
kpis.description: The portfolio of 500 cemeteries, including 312 combined funeral service and cemetery sites, across 44 states, 8 Canadian provinces, and other territories provides a substantial asset platform for memorialization services.
kpis.signal: Geographically diversified portfolio of real estate assets in North America

kpis.name: Investissements en acquisitions
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in acquiring funeral service and cemetery sites
kpis.description: Acquisition investments of $101.3 million in 2025 (22 funeral service sites and 2 cemeteries) reflect the company's selective growth strategy and continued portfolio optimization in areas offering attractive returns.
kpis.signal: Ongoing growth strategy through targeted acquisitions and new site development

kpis.name: Rachats d'actions
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in repurchasing the company's common shares
kpis.description: Share repurchases of $464.2 million in 2025 (5.86 million shares at $79.15 per share) represent an 85.9% increase from 2024 and reflect the company's commitment to returning excess cash flow to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Shareholder capital return with significant increase in repurchase activity

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.34 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.184 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 33.8% in the latest year.

risks.title: Market conditions affecting trust investments
risks.score_rationale: Trust funds related to prepaid funeral and cemetery property sales hold investment portfolios (equities, bonds, mutual funds) affected by market conditions outside the company's control

risks.title: Demographic trends and mortality rates
risks.score_rationale: Population growth, average age, and mortality rates are key but largely external factors affecting demand for funeral and cemetery services

risks.title: Credit risk exposure in trust funds
risks.score_rationale: Trust funds hold credit securities (bonds, fixed income funds) that expose the company to credit default risk from issuers

risks.title: Inflation risk and operating costs
risks.score_rationale: Inflation could increase labor costs, funeral merchandise costs, and operating expenses for funeral homes and cemeteries

ai_positioning.summary: The company SCI has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar terms in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F report. Therefore, its position on AI cannot be determined from this information.
